memories.content: Cutting too close to the minimum word limit (e.g., aiming right around the threshold) risks deterministic word count evaluation failures due to slight differences in tokenization or whitespace calculation.

When editing drafts to adhere to a strict range (160–220 words), target the middle of the range (e.g., ~180-190 words) instead of near 160 words to provide a safety buffer against borderline count discrepancies.

Structuring a multi-agent generation pipeline with a writer agent drafting the content and a dedicated editor agent performing final trimming and adherence audits reliably produces text conforming to strict formatting, structural, and length constraints.
